Data.title: SmsForwarder
Data.content:
This app monitors SMS messages, incoming calls and app notifications on Android and forwards them to other devices according to configured rules.
Make sure you understand what the app does.
Otherwise, uninstall it immediately.

Data.title: Fraud warning
Data.content:
This app is not involved in or a guarantor of any paid-task or rebate schemes. Avoid such schemes and beware of online fraud.
Confirm that you installed this app voluntarily for your own use.
Otherwise, uninstall it immediately.

Data.title: Before you begin
Data.content:
Read the Wiki before configuring the app.
If you encounter a problem, consult the FAQ first.
If you cannot find an answer, ask the support group and describe the problem clearly, including relevant configuration screenshots and logs.
